name: s22-anth-cli
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"

args: The test suite fails. Find the cause, fix it, and verify the fix.
Fix the failing test again if it fails, and also add a test that add() works with negative numbers.
